title: Application Timekeeping PTP Entity
description: Precision Time Protocol (linuxptp) configuration. Sub-microsecond accuracy for data centers and financial systems.

interface.description: Network interface for PTP (must support hardware timestamping).

slave_only.description: Run as slave only (never become grandmaster).

priority1.description: Clock priority for best master clock algorithm (0-255, lower wins).

phc2sys.description: phc2sys configuration for syncing PTP hardware clock to system clock.
